patch: Only declare pre-sm80 __hmax_nan/__hmin_nan fallbacks when CUDA is older than 12.9. CUDA 12.9 already declares them. Replace __FILE__ in NO_DEVICE_CODE diagnostics with a stable source label so native objects do not disclose build-machine paths; track that header as a build input.
validation: CUDA 12.9 sm75 compilation and actual RTX 4090 AnimeText inference passed. GPU dtype is F32 because portable sm75 kernels do not implement BF16.
